task.title: Relics: a damaged task should not stop link commands that name another task
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M24). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook relic list --linked-to <task>` and `workbook relic update --link <task>` fail with a bare message (exit 7) when any other task is damaged, even when given a full task ID. `relic show` and `relic list` carry on with a warning. Task commands fail the same way, so this matches tasks, but the message gives no context.

## Wanted

When the task named is healthy, answer and warn about the damaged one. At the least, make the message name the damaged task and say what to run.

## Done when

- With one damaged task in the checkout, `relic list --linked-to <healthy full ID>` answers.
- The message for a damaged task names it and the repair.
